name: pdist_metrics
expr: ds = pdist(A,'seuclidean'); dse = pdist(A,'seuclidean',[1 2 3]); dsp = pdist(A,'spearman'); dt = pdist(A2,'spearman'); cn = double(isnan(pdist([0 0;3 4],'cosine'))); rn = double(isnan(pdist([1 1;3 4],'correlation'))); P2 = pdist2(Px,Py,'seuclidean'); Q2 = pdist2(Px,Py,'spearman'); qn = double(isnan(Q2(1,2)));
comment: Sig: D = pdist(X, metric[, p|S]); D = pdist2(X, Y, metric). Covers the pdist-metrics bug fix (bugs/stats/pdist-metrics.md): 'seuclidean' (default per-column std scale + explicit scale vector S=[1 2 3]), 'spearman' (tiedrank rows then correlation distance, no-ties dsp(2)=dsp(3)=0.5 and ties dt(1)=1.5), 'cosine' zero-norm row -> NaN (was 1), and 'correlation' constant row -> NaN (MATLAB is source of truth; md named only cosine but MATLAB returns NaN for both). pdist2 variants: seuclidean default scale = std(X) (first arg); spearman ranks each side, Q2(1,1)=0.5 and Q2(1,2)=NaN (Py row 2 constant). NaN cases fingerprinted via double(isnan(.)) so the numeric comparator stays valid.
